_help: Armor stat effects (Skillz, Economy v2 / DESIGN §21, STATS_API.md). Read by scripts/combat/stat_effects.gd (StatEffects), which player.gd recalc_stats() uses (MAIN_HOOKS §21b). Each stat is the 5-piece total, capped at 100 (Inventory.total_armor_stats). effect = max x curve(stat / 100). curve 'ease_out' = 1 - (1 - x)^power (early points count most: 20 points already give 1 - 0.8^2 = 36% of max); 'linear' = x (the pre-v2 behaviour: 100 Agility = +20% speed, 100 Toughness = 30% damage reduction, ...). Jason v0.6.1: 'stat points don't visibly affect move speed, damage taken' - they did apply, but a typical 15-25 total moved speed 3-5% and damage 5-7%, which nobody can feel.

agility.name: Agility
agility._note: walk, sprint and crouch speed +25% at 100

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality._note: regen starts 2.5 s sooner (floor 1.5 s), +20 HP/s at 100
